across_options.issue: The offer field's texture changes: A is soft and cloudy with little visible linework; B has prominent curved mesh lines; C has much fainter lines. Texture belongs to ledger D5, not D3. This also changes the visual evidence for constitution B5 and Article 13's flat-gradient check.

The item imagery is not held constant. C uses a closer jacket crop with a different visible arrangement of folds, and its Nike shoes appear substantially whiter than the gray shoes in A and B. Lamp framing also changes. These differences affect item prominence independently of spacing (constitution Article 14.4 requires variants on one named axis).

The sale amount is visibly smaller in A than in B and C; its lime band also changes width. The peak amount's size and treatment are not the D3 spacing decision (ledger A3 and D6; constitution Article 14.4).
